title: Ackman's Pershing Square takes stake in Microsoft, citing 'compelling' valuation
title_zh: 阿克曼的潘兴广场入股微软，理由是估值“令人信服”
summary: Bill Ackman's hedge fund Pershing Square will disclose a new position in Microsoft later in the day, the billionaire investor said on Friday, arguing ‌that the tech giant sits at a "highly compelling valuation".
summary_zh: 这位亿万富翁投资者周五表示，比尔·阿克曼 (Bill Ackman) 的对冲基金潘兴广场 (Pershing Square) 将在当天晚些时候披露其在微软的新仓位，并认为这家科技巨头的估值“非常引人注目”。
